descriptor.scene: The hollow architecture is the subject: a tall, hastily raised tower seen up close, filling most of the frame, and up close it is wrong. Doors on its upper floors open onto empty air with no balcony and no floor beyond the threshold. An exterior stair climbs the facade and simply ends halfway, hanging. Through the large unfinished window openings the floors read as thin shells: rooms with no backs, walls with nothing behind them, like stage scenery seen from the wrong side. The craftsmanship is fast, not evil: pale fresh materials, joints unfinished, edges never closed. At the tower's base, tiny against it, the hot founder stands looking up, face unreadable. Warm daylight, and the wrongness is quiet: nothing is collapsing, it is simply hollow. Composition: the tower rises through the left and center of the frame; the upper right sky stays calm and open.
negatives: people on the stairs or in the doorways (the tiny founder at the base is the only figure)
descriptor._caption: Up close, the floors are hollow. Doors open onto air. Stairs end halfway. He ships whatever the engine produces, because his neighbors are loud and he is afraid of falling behind.
